title: Arterial Destiffening Effects of SGLT2 Inhibition in Veterans With Obesity
official: Arterial Destiffening Effects of SGLT2 Inhibition in Veterans With Obesity
summary: The study will assign participants to take either the medication, empagliflozin or a placebo for 12 weeks. The goal of the study is to determine the effects of empagliflozin on arterial health in Veterans with obesity.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Body mass index (BMI) 30-45 kilograms per square meter (kg/m2)
* 30-60 years of age at randomization
* Evidence of arterial stiffening (defined as Carotid femoral PWV\>age-predicted) at screening visit (PMID: 20530030), or presence of Stage I hypertension or higher (PMID: 30354655), or current use of antihypertensive agents

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to provide consent
* Diabetes mellitus
* Uncontrolled hypertension (\>180/90 millimeters of mercury) or systolic \<100 millimeters of mercury at screening visit
* Known history of cardiovascular disease: heart failure, ischemic heart disease, peripheral artery disease or stroke
* Diagnosis of chronic kidney disease
* Active cancer (excluding basal cell carcinoma or stage 1 squamous cell carcinoma of the skin)
* Excessive alcohol consumption (\>14 drinks/week for men, \>7 drinks/week for women)
* Use of GLP-1 analogs or SGLT2 inhibitors
* Use of hormone replacement therapy
* Use of pharmacological therapy for weight loss
* Body weight changes \>10% within the past 6 months
* History of hypersensitivity to nitrates
* History of ketoacidosis
* History of recurrent UTIs or mycotic genital infections
* Use of anticoagulants
* Change in anti-hypertensive medication regimen (if in use) during the last 90 days
* Pregnancy
